newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $290 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $290 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday are expected to total $290 million in 22 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $64 million in four sales, with a $24 million Westlake Local School District, Ohio, deal through Seasongood & Mayer topping the list.
On the competitive side, 14 sales totaling $226 million are on the schedule. A $92 million Virgina Public School Authority deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional $8 million sale from Austin Housing Finance Corp., Texas, is on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Thursday, depending on market conditions.
